newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-BRUNDLE GETS DOUBLE ASSIGNMENT.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BRUNDLE GETS DOUBLE ASSIGNMENT.

text.p: Former Le Mans winner Martin Brundle of Britain is to be lead driver in the Nissan GT for the 24 Hours race, and a director of Arrows Grand Prix International.
The double announcement was made on Monday by Arrows chairman and chief executive Tom Walkinshaw.
Brundle, who won Le Mans for Jaguar in 1990, said: "This is a great challenge and an opportunity for me to explore a management position while still actively involved in a driving programme."

The veteran of 158 Grands Prix, Brundle had been left without a job following the decision of his former Jordan team to opt for Italian Giancarlo Fisichella to partner German Ralf Schumacher at the outfit this year.
